### Probability Calculator (`probcalc`)
<span class="badge-r">R Shiny</span> <span class="badge-tech">Statistics</span> <span class="badge-tech">Multilingual</span>

An interactive application designed to compute and visualize discrete and continuous probability distributions. Allows calculating cumulative probabilities, quantiles, and generating density plots with full support for English, Portuguese, and Spanish.
